description: Strategically meaningful ports for India's crude oil and energy supply chain. Includes real-world origin export terminals and Indian import ports.

ports.name: Ras Tanura Terminal
ports.role: Primary Saudi Aramco export terminal. World's largest oil loading facility. ~1.4M BPD to India.

ports.name: King Fahad Industrial Port (Jubail)
ports.role: Major petrochemical and crude export hub. Arabian Gulf coast.

ports.name: Yanbu Export Terminal
ports.role: Red Sea export terminal. Feeds Suez route to India. Key bypass route.

ports.name: Basra Oil Terminal (ABOT/KAAOT)
ports.role: Iraq's primary crude export terminal in the Persian Gulf. ~900K BPD to India.

ports.name: Khor Al-Amaya Terminal
ports.role: Secondary Iraqi offshore loading platform in Persian Gulf.

ports.name: Das Island Terminal (ADNOC)
ports.role: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. primary LNG and condensate export hub.

ports.name: Jebel Ali Port
ports.role: World's largest man-made port. Key UAE distribution hub for refined products.

ports.name: Port of Fujairah
ports.role: Major bunkering hub outside Strait of Hormuz. Key storage for Indian IOCs.

ports.name: Mina Al-Ahmadi Terminal
ports.role: Kuwait's main crude oil export terminal. KPC operates tanker berths.

ports.name: Mina Al-Fahal (PDO Terminal)
ports.role: Petroleum Development Oman's main export terminal on Gulf of Oman.

ports.name: Kharg Island Terminal
ports.role: Iran's primary crude export terminal. Historically significant for India pre-sanctions.

ports.name: Novorossiysk Marine Terminal
ports.role: Russia's main Black Sea export terminal (CPC Pipeline). Key post-Ukraine sanction route.

ports.name: Primorsk Oil Terminal
ports.role: Baltic Sea terminal. Major Urals crude export point via BPS-2 pipeline.

ports.name: Ust-Luga Oil Terminal
ports.role: Baltic Sea. Exports Urals, KEBCO, vacuum gasoil to India post-sanctions.

ports.name: Kozmino (ESPO) Export Terminal
ports.role: East Siberia-Pacific Ocean pipeline terminus. ESPO blend shipped to Indian east coast refineries.

ports.name: Bonny Export Terminal
ports.role: Shell-operated terminal. Bonny Light crude is prized for low-sulfur content by Indian refineries.

ports.name: Qua Iboe Terminal
ports.role: ExxonMobil-operated Nigerian export terminal. Qua Iboe Light crude exported to India.

ports.name: Houston Ship Channel
ports.role: Post-OPEC independence, USA became India's top supplier. WTI-linked shale crudes.

ports.name: Port of Corpus Christi
ports.role: Largest US crude export port by volume. Gateway for Permian Basin crude to India.

ports.name: Es Sider Terminal
ports.role: Libya's largest crude export terminal. Es Sider crude shipped to India.

ports.name: Arzew LNG & Oil Terminal
ports.role: Algeria's main energy export hub. LNG and Saharan Blend crude to India.

ports.name: Sikka / Vadinar Port (Reliance)
ports.role: Reliance Industries Jamnagar refinery. World's largest single-site refinery. 1.24M BPD.

ports.name: Mumbai / JNPT (BPCL)
ports.role: BPCL Mumbai Refinery import terminal. Also handles SPM offshore crude.

ports.name: New Mangalore Port (MRPL)
ports.role: MRPL (ONGC subsidiary) refinery import berth. 15 MMTPA capacity.

ports.name: Cochin Port / Kochi Refinery (BPCL)
ports.role: BPCL Kochi Refinery import terminal. 15.5 MMTPA. South India hub.

ports.name: Paradip Port (IOCL Refinery)
ports.role: IOCL Paradip Refinery east coast import hub. 15 MMTPA capacity.

ports.name: Visakhapatnam Port (HPCL)
ports.role: HPCL Visakhapatnam Refinery. 8.3 MMTPA. Receives ESPO and Middle East crude.

ports.name: Kamarajar Port (Ennore / Chennai)
ports.role: CPCL Chennai Petroleum import terminal. Also HPCL future refinery site.

ports.name: Haldia Dock Complex (IOCL)
ports.role: IOCL Haldia Refinery import terminal. Northeast India supply hub.

ports.name: Jurong Island (Singapore)
ports.role: Major Asian refining and petrochemical hub.

ports.name: Port of Rotterdam
ports.role: Europe's largest seaport and major oil hub.

ports.name: Kandla Port (Deendayal)
ports.role: Major port on Gulf of Kutch for POL imports.

ports.name: Al Faw Grand Port
ports.role: Major Iraqi port under development.

ports.name: Gwadar Port
ports.role: Strategic deep seaport on Arabian Sea.

ports.name: Port of Colombo
ports.role: Key transshipment hub in Indian Ocean.

ports.name: Port of Djibouti
ports.role: Strategic port at the mouth of the Red Sea.
